title: White Moss
subtitle: Oh! My mind trembles at its ethereality!

items.text: A Nightmare at Green Lake

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: You offered us the best odds. We have The Last Girl!

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Please don't say that. I'm not that good. It was pure luck.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: No, you are awesome. You struck away a knife with a branch and took the murderer's life with his own weapon.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I can't be wrong with your part to play here. You are The Last Girl!

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: I should have noticed this earlier. You are gentle, simple, and kind-hearted enough to put yourself in danger to save others.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: No one is more suitable for this role than you. This is your part.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Good, good. From now on, I will stay right next to you, because where you are is always going to be the safe place.

items.speaker: Anne
items.text: Jennifer ...?!

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Blondie, I need to remind you that the character who relies on others always leads to a miserable end.

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Ugh, get lost! Have you ever wondered why people dislike you?

items.speaker: Blonney
items.text: Anne, promise me, you will keep me safe with this "special power" of yours!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: This is good. Blonney seems to be more relaxed now. She smiles a lot more as well.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: She is changing. Not bad.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ms. Tooth Fairy, please take a look at this.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: A piece of moss ... with mud, and a sour and earthy smell ...

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: It smells the same as the key. I found this smell in that car as well as on the sofa in the cabin.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Where did you get this?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There's a special area near the woods where the temperature and humidity levels are higher, so mosses are ubiquitous.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Any signs of artificial cultivation?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm not sure. This place has been deserted for so long. We haven't found any trace of human activities.
After examining the moss and thinking in silence, Tooth Fairy nods confirmedly.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: This is a potion.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Like most moss-made potions, it paralyzes the central neural system of humans. The subject will become impulsive, confused, and mad.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: They permeated the whole campsite with the rain, taking away the sanity from Jason, Freddie, and Michael, like what would happen in a horror movie.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: No surprise. Ordinary people would never behave as foolish as the main characters in a horror movie.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: It's said that a similar smell was also found on the Zeno Youth Force. Were they controlled by the moss here?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Yes, the changes of personality can be one of the effects of the moss.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So the moss not only affects humans, it also works on arcanists.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What about us? Why haven't we been affected?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Time, it takes time.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Humans perceive the world through the use of reason. They are the creature of logic and senses. However, they soon lose their sanity when they meet insanity.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Arcanists are not the same. We were born with chaotic, mixed emotions. Our innate sensitivity to feelings and potion resistance are stronger.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: The Zeno Youth Force stayed here for an adequately long period to be contaminated. It will also affect us when the time comes.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Perhaps we've lost our minds without realizing it.
Horropedia puts both hands behind his head and sinks into the sofa.
But soon he sits up straight again and approaches the table eagerly.

items.speaker: Horropedia
items.text: Oh, what are these? They look appealing. Why hasn't anyone told me about them?

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: I found them in the attic. These tiny and exquisite items have a lot to dig into.
Tooth Fairy looks up at the dark attic.

items.speaker: Tooth Fairy
items.text: Pity, I still haven't found a tooth.
